# Art Credits

All models are CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Commercial use allowed, no attribution required (credited anyway). Each folder under `Assets/_Aron/Art` keeps the original `License.txt`.

| Folder | Files | Source | Author | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Art/Characters/Quaternius | Kimono_Male.fbx, Kimono_Female.fbx, Ninja_Sand.fbx, BlueSoldier_Male.fbx | Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019), https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html | Quaternius | CC0 |
| Art/Animals/Quaternius | Horse.fbx, Alpaca.fbx | Ultimate Animated Animal Pack, https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html | Quaternius | CC0 |
| Art/Animals/QuaterniusVol2 | Eagle.fbx | Animated Animals Low Poly (Vol. 2), https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly | Quaternius | CC0 |
| Art/Kenney/Platformer | crates, coin, flag, spring, barrel, chest, sign, fences, blocks, platform, rocks, stones | Platformer Kit, https://kenney.nl/assets/platformer-kit | Kenney | CC0 |
| Art/Kenney/Castle | walls, square tower pieces, gate, stairs, banner | Castle Kit 2.0, https://kenney.nl/assets/castle-kit | Kenney | CC0 |
| Art/Kenney/Nature | palm trees, rocks, cacti, bush, stone | Nature Kit, https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit | Kenney | CC0 |

`Art/Kenney/Platformer/Textures/colormap.png` is the kit's colormap with the green swatches shifted to sand tones for the desert setting.

There is no camel in either pack, so the camel is the Alpaca model scaled up with a generated hump, saddle blanket and wooden saddle frame (`Assets/_Aron/Editor/AronArt.Animals.cs`). The falcon is the Eagle model, scaled down and recoloured. The Vol. 2 zip ships no licence file; the OpenGameArt page lists it as CC0, so its folder carries the same Quaternius CC0 text.

Characters are recoloured at build time (white thobe and red shemagh for Aron, black abaya for Noura). The shemagh, agal and handbag props and the arch tower are generated by `Assets/_Aron/Editor/AronArt.cs` and `AronLevelBuilder.cs`.

Sfx/hit.wav is impactPunch_medium_001.ogg from Kenney Impact Sounds (https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds); Sfx/swing.wav is knifeSlice.ogg from Kenney RPG Audio (https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio). Both CC0.
